images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1: edit target, the existing emerald-black Wyvern illustration. Preserve this specific creature's identity, emerald-black scales, sharp swept horns, glowing amber predatory eyes, open fanged dragon jaws and sophisticated colorful painterly fantasy storybook style.
Requested change: turn the perched creature into a MUCH MORE VISUALLY DOMINANT HUGE WYVERN FLYING IN OPEN SKY. Its large detailed head, muscular chest and body take center stage, while it soars forcefully with both vast bat-membrane wings spread in a strong airborne three-quarter side pose. Show the whole creature suspended in air. Exactly TWO hind legs with two hooked feet tucked or extended beneath the rear torso, and exactly TWO wings serving as its forelimbs. NO separate front legs, NO separate arms and NO extra feet. Preserve strict wyvern anatomy and show both hind feet clearly. The long powerful tail sweeps within frame.
Replace the ground, cliff, ruined coastal landscape and ocean with an OPEN PALE CORAL-BLUE SKY, soft low-contrast coral dawn light and pale blue cloud washes. No rock under its feet; nothing supports it. Keep the background quiet and airy so the enormous dark emerald creature has a crisp striking silhouette.
Composition: landscape 5:3, full-bleed, creature covers roughly 75–85% of the image and appears much larger and more imposing as the card's central focus. Keep the head, hind feet, tail and both full wing tips inside the frame with some natural sky margin. Enlarge the visual weight of head/torso while keeping the complete wing silhouette readable. Ferocious mature soaring dragon, not a cute creature.
Invariants: same emerald-black individual and gouache/watercolor textured illustrated finish with fine ink-like scale detail. Exactly two wing forelimbs plus two hind legs. No people, other creatures, gore, text, signatures, logos, watermarks, frame graphics, photorealism or 3D.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1: edit target, the current crimson-and-gold feathered Amphiptere. Preserve the vivid crimson/gold palette, two feathered wings, long continuous serpentine body, pale turquoise storm-cloud setting and sophisticated textured gouache/watercolor fantasy storybook finish.
Requested change: make this creature substantially MORE BADASS, intimidating and DRAGONLIKE. Replace its relatively graceful expression/body language with a brutal angular HORNED DRAGON HEAD, sharper swept armored brow and horns, intense narrow glowing predatory eyes, a heavy muscular jaw and several prominent huge curved ivory fangs. It must look like a powerful dragon head, not a bird beak or friendly mascot. Thicken and strengthen the neck and serpentine torso into a muscular armored adult body with crisp overlapping scales and heavier chest plating, while keeping the long uninterrupted legless body and tapered tail clear.
Pose: a forceful three-quarter forward attack swoop, head thrust toward the viewer and slightly to the right, fanged jaws open in a dangerous roar, strong tension through the thick S-curving body. Spectacular ENORMOUS DARK-RED AND GOLD FEATHERED WINGS flared powerfully from its shoulders; more predatory sculpted feather shapes with rich dark crimson shadows and luminous gold tips. Exactly TWO wings and absolutely NO legs, NO separate arms, NO hands or feet anywhere. Keep feathers only on the wings/crest; torso remains visibly scaled reptilian serpent.
Framing: landscape 5:3 full-bleed, prominent central creature about 70–80% of frame. BOTH COMPLETE WINGS, horns, head and tail fit fully inside the image, with natural pale sky breathing room at the wing tips. Keep the quieter pale cool turquoise cloud background and strong warm red/gold foreground contrast. Background should not compete with the creature.
Invariants: same crimson/gold feathered-serpent individual, exact two-wing/no-leg anatomy, colorful painterly storybook style. No breath effect, fire, people, other creatures, gore, text, signatures, logos, watermarks, frame graphics, photograph or 3D.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: entirely NEW blue-green default Leviathan illustration for a Dragon Database form card.
Primary request: a new badass mature aquatic dragon individual, created from text alone, with a strong unmistakable BLUE-GREEN/Jade identity and a distinct warm coastal sunset scene. Not a red or vermillion individual recolored.
Subject identity: a massive muscular TURQUOISE AND EMERALD-JADE LEVIATHAN with bright SILVER ventral armor, overlapping jewel-green/blue scales, a powerful broad crocodilian dragon muzzle, exactly two short backward-curved silver horns, a low serrated aquatic crest and intense narrow silver-amber eyes. It snarls with sharp ivory fangs as its large head swings LEFT over the surface, stern ancient predatory power. Long continuous aquatic SEA-SERPENT body in a sweeping low S across a clear coastal lagoon, with a broad tail fin and several unmistakable short broad fish-like side fins. Absolutely NO legs, NO feet, NO terrestrial claws, NO arms and NO wings. The head, neck, long entire body curve, fins and tail remain readable through the shallow water and above it. Avoid the long antler-like horns and red-white markings of a generic roaring sea dragon.
Scene: a quiet deep WARM VIOLET AND GOLDEN COASTAL SUNSET, low-contrast violet sea stacks far away, a broad luminous gold reflection on a calm lavender coastal sea, softly painted warm-purple sky and minimal golden cloud glow. No storm, lighthouse or violent dark crashing surf. A few restrained spray arcs around the creature emphasize powerful motion without hiding its body. The rich green-blue/silver subject is sharply separated from the warm violet-gold background.
Composition/style: landscape 5:3 full-bleed, one powerful central creature dominates 65–80% of the frame with a crisp readable silhouette and room around the head, fins and tail. Sophisticated colorful gouache/watercolor fantasy storybook painting, finely painted scales and subtle ink-like detail on the creature, softer quieter atmospheric epic backdrop. Mature and ferocious, no cute proportions. Whole defining anatomy fits inside frame for a shallow card crop.
Constraints: one aquatic serpent only. No wings or legs, no extra creatures or people, no text, letters, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, frame graphics, gore, photograph or 3D. Preserve the new jade/turquoise/silver palette and warm-violet/gold coastal identity.
